patterns.title: Separate AI reasoning from deterministic application core
patterns.statement: Keep auth, persistence, domain workflows, and other deterministic paths outside model nondeterminism; reach AI through explicit boundaries (agents with structured outputs, or well-defined APIs).

patterns.title: Isolate domain engines behind clear API boundaries
patterns.statement: Put core calculation or inference behind a package/API boundary that presentation and transport layers call into — hos_engine without Django/network deps; FastAPI inference separate from React; AI behind defined backend APIs.

patterns.title: Validate behavior before trusting coverage or expected metrics
patterns.statement: Treat high coverage and aspirational README metrics as insufficient alone: mutation testing exposed survived clinical faults despite ~98% line coverage; committed notebook PSNR/SSIM supersede README expected bands.

patterns.title: Prefer fail-safe serving defaults under deploy risk
patterns.statement: When GPU/CUDA packaging is unreliable, force CPU inference for the public API path; when LLM outputs are noisy, normalize with allow-lists, clamps, and boundary assertions rather than trusting raw model strings.
